title: Market data and market entry for pharmaceutical manufacturers | Nazryx
description: Nazryx is a market data and market entry agency for pharmaceutical manufacturers. We show you where your products can sell across 14 frontier markets, then take them there.

sections.eyebrow: Bridging the gap in medical trade across frontier markets
sections.title: Enter frontier markets
sections.lede: Nazryx is a market data and market entry agency for pharmaceutical manufacturers. We show you where your products can sell, then take them there, with the registrations in your name.

sections.title: Most export launches fail
sections.lede: Not because of the product or the price. Because of what was decided before anyone read the market.

items.title: The wrong market
items.text: Chosen from a brochure, not from the national register. Crowded categories look open; open ones go unnoticed.

items.title: The wrong partner
items.text: Picked because they replied first, not because they sell your category or reach the right buyers.

items.title: Registration found too late
items.text: The route is worked out after the product is chosen. A year and a dossier are lost to dead ends.

sections.title: Two services.
sections.accent: One goal: your products selling abroad.

items.label: Market data
items.title: Know what's open before you commit.
items.text: We read each market's register, pharmacy shelves and state tenders against your catalogue, product by product.
points: Market read for your whole catalogue

items.label: Market entry management
items.title: Launch, with the registrations in your name.
items.text: We register your products, appoint the importer, reach the doctors and bid in state rounds. Paid on results.

items.title: Read the market
items.text: Your catalogue against the register, shelves and state buyers of each target market, in 2–3 weeks.

items.title: Plan the launch
items.text: Which products, which markets, which registration route, and in which order.

items.title: Enter and manage
items.text: Filing in your name, importer appointed, doctors and state bids, reported every week.

items.title: Market read
items.text: What is open, thin or crowded for your products, per market.

items.title: Product profiles
items.text: Two pages per product: the market, then the plan.

items.title: Launch plan
items.text: Filing waves, route, importer and volumes by year.

items.title: Weekly report
items.text: Orders, stock, listings, what to push and what to fix.

sections.title: 14 markets on 3 continents.
sections.lede: Frontier markets import most of their medicines. We read them and run them, one market at a time.

items.title: 12 eye-care medicines. Zero suppliers.
items.text: One market's register read against its essential medicines list: twelve eye-care medicines with no registered supplier, and a distributor already asking for one of them.

items.title: 53 registrations. All veterinary.
items.text: A widely used molecule looked saturated on paper. Every registration was for animal use. For human medicine, the market was open.

items.title: Paid on results
items.text: Commission on sales, agreed per market. No fee for introductions.

items.title: Registrations in your name
items.text: You keep the product, dossier, plant, brand and registrations.

items.title: Evidence before contracts
items.text: You see the market read before anything is signed.

sections.title: Send your product list.
sections.text: Tell us which markets interest you. We will show you what is open there.
